work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Epistle CCLVI to King Ferdinand VII of Spain (address LF43973–43974, protocol LF43977, salutation LF43980–43981) commends the nuncio Luigi (Amat), archbishop of Nicaea, and ends with its own 22 August 1833 closing at LF44020–44023, before numeral CCLVII at LF44026. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF43977–43977; the source closing at LF44020–44023 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die vigesima secunda augusti mille- simo octingentesimo trigesimo tertio, pontifica- tus Nostri anno tertio. Its own provenance note 1 (Ex Archivio Brevium ad Principes, LF44071) is printed at the foot of leaf 304 inside CCLVII's frame and is excluded. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
